unwindFamily.evidenceBoundary: Exact declared exception-table framing and complete parent triples establish selected-primary range membership, including nested and noncontiguous chains. Version 1/2 code-slot contents, fixed-allocation consistency, handlers, managed control flow, live MethodInfo and execution remain separate proofs; adjacency and start-address-only joins are not used.

conditionalDomain.execution: Valid selected reads/writes and frames; normal ABI-compatible guard calls preserve RBX/RDI. The same read cookie is used for returned old-word decoding and stored new-word encoding.
conditionalDomain.identity: The new and returned words are raw bits, not proved callable objects; setter invocation and same-cookie state in a subsequent getter are not observed.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Complete owned setter CFG/frame, actual guard calls, selected cookie/encoded read/store operands and rotate widths.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Returns ROR64(oldEncoded XOR cookie,cookie AND 63); stores ROR64(newWord,64-(cookie AND 63)) XOR cookie. Both guards receive zero ECX.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: A subsequent getter using the same cookie inverts that stored encoding. Guard side effects, object/callback identity and publication epoch remain separate conditions.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: A reference-containing owned definition is not evidence that the client called it or that all other writes use it.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Setter callers/invocation, unowned direct writer entry/callers, all-writer guard coverage and live cookie/critical-section state.
